name: Escorting Erland
summary: In Silverpine, Deathstalker Erland needs help reaching his partner. Wolves have trapped him in a shelter, and he must cross their hunting ground to reach Rane Yorick.

sections.title: Cornered by Wolves
sections.body: Deathstalker Erland is trapped in a shelter by hungry wolves. Even seasoned Forsaken scouts can be outmatched by Silverpine's wilds. The wolves circle the ruined refuge, drawn to the little flesh left on Erland's withered frame. Alone, he cannot break through their pack.

sections.title: A Treacherous Crossing
sections.body: Deathstalker Erland needs to reach his partner, Rane Yorick, near the Ivar Patch. The way crosses ground prowled by wolves. Once you guide him past them, Erland runs the last stretch to Rane Yorick's outpost. There, the scouts can bring their intelligence together for the Undercity.

faq.q: Why are the wolves hunting an undead scout?
faq.answer: The wolves may be so hungry that they see a desiccated Forsaken corpse as food. Silverpine's feral wildlife attacks anything that crosses its territory.

faq.q: Who is Deathstalker Erland reporting to?
faq.answer: Deathstalker Erland reports to his scouting partner, Deathstalker Rane Yorick, who keeps watch at a nearby farmhouse near the Ivar Patch. Together, they monitor threats in the woods for the Forsaken.

The escort leads Erland from his refuge to the farm near the Ivar Patch, where he reports to Rane Yorick. After speaking with Rane, Erland goes inside and upstairs to check on the injured Quinn Yorick.

faq.q: What happens after Erland is rescued?
faq.answer: Once Erland is safely reunited with Rane Yorick, the two scouts prepare their findings. Rane then entrusts you with carrying their compiled dispatch back to the Sepulcher, as described in The Deathstalkers' Report.

faq.q: Are there other threats encountered during the escort?
faq.answer: Wolves patrolling the open ground between Erland's refuge and the farm near the Ivar Patch are the main danger.

faq.q: What role do Deathstalkers play in Silverpine?
faq.answer: Deathstalkers are Forsaken rogues, scouts, and assassins. In Silverpine Forest, they go ahead of the main garrisons to track Scourge stragglers, Worgen incursions, feral beasts, and Alliance movements.

angles.text: As a Forsaken, you know Deathstalkers rely on teamwork and stealth. Erland pinned down by beasts shows the danger Silverpine's wilds pose to the newly risen.
As a member of the Horde, you help isolated Deathstalkers gather crucial reconnaissance for forces pushing outward from the Sepulcher.
